issues.title: TNFD Nature-Related Financial Disclosure
issues.hover_description: Agriculture IS the nature risk. TNFD (Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures) framework requires disclosure of dependencies on pollinators, soil health, and freshwater. Nature loss = production collapse. Q1 because financial AND societal impact are both existential. ESRS E4 mandatory.

issues.title: Soil Degradation & Carbon Sequestration
issues.hover_description: Topsoil lost at 10x regeneration rate. Each 1% drop in organic matter = 8% yield reduction. Regenerative agriculture investment protects long-term asset value. ESRS E4.

issues.title: Water Depletion & Nitrate Runoff
issues.hover_description: Aquifer over-extraction + nitrogen runoff causing algal blooms. EU Nitrates Directive violation risk. Water is both the biggest cost AND the biggest impact. ESRS E3 mandatory.

issues.title: Smallholder Farmer Livelihoods
issues.hover_description: 3,200 contract smallholders earning below living income. Cascading supply risk + ESRS S2 mandatory disclosure. Long-term sourcing security depends on farmer viability.

issues.title: Biodiversity Restoration Commitments
issues.hover_description: 30x30 target (CBD Kunming-Montreal). High societal impact — pollinator collapse threatens food security. Financial impact: medium (regulatory + market access). ESRS E4.

issues.title: Competitor Crop Protection Technology
issues.hover_description: New biopesticide entrants threatening market share. Pure financial risk. No direct ESG harm. ESRS 2 SBM-3.

issues.title: LED Retrofits in Admin Buildings
issues.hover_description: Saves 12 tCO2/yr. Negligible at farm scale. Classic immaterial distractor.

issues.title: Executive Carbon Offset Purchases
issues.hover_description: Symbolic. Farm Scope 1 emissions are orders of magnitude larger. Greenwashing risk.
